integrity: An exact algebraic proof and standalone rational exhaustive checker accompany the result. The latter verifies only bounded finite instances; generality derives from proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite trees with one fixed infected root, independent vertex transmissibilities and conditionally independent outgoing edge transmissions; the variance comparison is relative to matched bond percolation on the same tree, not across shapes or on graphs with cycles. General epidemic-variance antecedents exist. No claim of independent scientific audit.
title: Exact outbreak-variance excess and sharp branching extremizers on rooted contact trees
